limitations: User dimensions; no strength design or code certification
Footing / Column / Beam detailed BBS only
Offset laps checked against parallel main bars; no whole-model clash check
Scale / shear / mirror, edited bars, and changed or missing hosts blocked
Upright Z rotation placement; explicit review before reinforcement regeneration
Old baked host transforms require reconstruction; adopt untouched old hosts through placement first
Centreline bars are edges, not solids; surface-only export/render requires solid mode
RB/DB/ASTM grades are specified metadata; no physical ribs or certification
Performance results are synthetic 29-bar fixture, not a whole-house FPS benchmark
Detailed slabs/stairs, drawing sheets, architecture/MEP and PDF/OCR remain future work
